description: This file defines the 'CheckBoxes' class, a component of a form library within the Goteo project, specifically handling the representation and management of a set of checkbox elements as part of a form element system.

classes.name: CheckBoxes
classes.description: Represents a collection of checkbox elements within a form, allowing initialization with options, setting of values, and assignment of HTML attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a collection of checkbox options based on provided data, creating CheckBox instances as needed and setting their properties based on current form values.
